hook_say: Here is what a $350 half truck load really pays two people once the drive, the truck and taxes are counted.

rows.label: What you charge now

rows.label: Break-even price (no profit)
rows.why: Labor on site $187.09, drive time $124.73, vehicle $22.80 and supplies $75, all at the $62.36 break-even rate.

rows.label: What you lose on this job
rows.why: At $350 the job pays $59.62 less than it costs you. The check line says it plainly: below your floor.
